concept: Review and integration: gratitude as a lens that coexists with real struggle and real ambition
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across perspective, appreciating people now, and holding gratitude alongside ambition — what's changed in how you think about this?
exercise.practice: Student identifies one real place in their life to practice this Pillar this week

assessment.success_marker: student connects at least two of the three teen-stage scenarios into a coherent personal view
